description: The structured result of an investigation. `model` is what the model writes; the API validates it, resolves its citations against the tool-call ledger, adds the API-written fields and stores `stored`. A model that supplies an API-written field is rejected.

summary.description: The vulnerability and why it matters.

claims.description: Every factual statement about the project or an advisory. Each cites the calls it relies on as call:<n>, 1 to 4 per claim (an empty list is rejected as uncited_claim by the API).

uncertainties.description: What the model could not establish. May be empty only when noUncertaintyReason is given.
